verdict.rationale: LM Studio's first-party site says its Bionic agent can create and edit documents, with every change saved automatically. That covers agent drafting, editing and auto-save as written. Community hands-on feedback confirms Bionic works as an agentic harness but does not specifically test document editing. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the document workspace (formats, versioning, how edits are applied), independent hands-on corroboration of document editing and auto-save.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically

citations.quote: Work with Bionic to create and edit documents. Every change is automatically saved, so you can work with your agent freely.
I really love LM Studio so I gave Bionic a shot immediately. First impression: it works great
